notes: §1985:XIII.4.8.2 prints USE AFTER STANDARD {EXCEPTION|ERROR} PROCEDURE ON {{file-name-1}...|OUTPUT|EXTEND} with USE, AFTER and PROCEDURE underlined (confirmed on the rendered page 654); INPUT, I-O and GLOBAL come to an 85 program from §1985:VII.4.6.2 and §1985:X.5.5.2, so the 85 compiler accepts the union. The grammar's Format 1 (useStatement over useOnTarget) admits the words, VersionConformancePass.VisitUseStatement refuses an omitted AFTER or PROCEDURE at 85 (COBOL0900), and DeclBindUse binds the scope, refusing a file in two USEs, a mode written twice (SR6) and a sort file (COBOL0897). Probed at 85 with report files: ON R1 R2 runs for 30 (bad path), 35 (absent EXTEND) and 41 (EXTEND while open); ON OUTPUT and ON EXTEND fire for their modes; a file-name USE excludes that file from ON OUTPUT; INPUT and GLOBAL I-O accepted and never fire; ON R1 R1 accepted; missing AFTER or PROCEDURE COBOL0900; empty ON and ON OUTPUT EXTEND / ON R1 OUTPUT syntax errors; OUTPUT twice and R1 in two USEs COBOL0897; RD name or unknown name COBOL0897; USE AFTER EXCEPTION CONDITION COBOL0877. Witness: file-name, OUTPUT and EXTEND declaratives over two report files, the EXTEND one firing with 35.

next.reason: 1985: "USE AFTER STANDARD {EXCEPTION|ERROR} PROCEDURE ON {file-name-1 …|OUTPUT|EXTEND}, with AFTER underlined"; 2023: "USE [GLOBAL] AFTER STANDARD … ON {file-name-1…|INPUT|OUTPUT|I-O|EXTEND}; AFTER is not underlined". 2023 Format 1 adds INPUT, I-O and optional GLOBAL, and makes AFTER an optional word, so it accepts programs the 1985 Report Writer format refuses.
